profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Costco Travel
profile.summary:
Professional full stack software developer with a track record of delivering projects on-time and on-budget.  Self-motivated to learn new technologies and apply them to customer solutions right away.  Eager to join a scrum team as a Java developer.

I have previously been in a contract position with the Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center where I am customizing a lab's Laboratory Information System (LIMS).  They used Labkey software and I grew very proficient in developing in Labkey.  This position required the use of varied programming languages and platforms including Java, SQL, R, javascript, and XML parsing.

I have extensive experience in web development, having built most of my biological applications as web applications.  In 2012 I started my own business developing websites and web applications for others.

Going further back than that, my work has been in computer programming around genomics and proteomics.  I've developed software, databases, and workflows for the management and analysis of lists of proteins identified in mass spectrometry experiments.  The analysis software includes network visualization of proteins and their known interactions, ID mapping, calculating the statistical significance of over representation of proteins in a certain metabolic pathway, and set analyses with Venn Diagram visualizations.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer I
positions.description: A lead developer in the Online Member Experience division. Projects included updating our website to a responsive look and feel with accessibility, integrating user-generated content on our website with TurnTo Reviews, and API integration in the cruise booking workflow.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Freelance bioinformatician and software engineer.  I consult with clients, create a solution to their needs, and fully implement and deploy it myself.  As of late I've been working mostly with Java code and with the Labkey Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS).

Clients include some of Seattle's well known research institutions and private corporations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained proteomics IT infrastructure and software.  This included developing custom applications in Java, PHP, or C/C++.  I also wrangled many statistical data with R and Perl and developed some mySQL databases.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As part of the Seattle Proteome Center, who developed the famous Trans-Proteomic Pipeline (or TPP), I developed software that was appended to the end of the pipeline.  That is, once the pipeline produced its list of identified proteins found within a given sample, that list was then loaded into my Google Web Toolkit (GWT)-developed software in order to explore functional relationships between the proteins, metabolic pathway enrichment analysis, interaction network analysis (Flash/Flex component), and data look-up features.  Heavy Java, AJAX, mySQL Database, and Hibernate development.  

Also participated in the development of Corra, a similar GWT application for targeted mass spectrometry.

positions.title: Biodesign Institute - Research Assistant
positions.description: As part of my Master's research, I was a lab member in the Center for Evolutionary Functional Genomics, analyzing and computationally processing images of gene expression patterns on fruit fly embryos.  We developed a resource called www.flyexpress.net, and my research looked at the expression patterns of transcription factor genes vs. the patterns of expression of genes which we thought they regulated.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Developed a website which included a BLAST search engine for a newly sequenced microorganism.

positions.title: Business Solutions Developer
positions.description: Essentially, I was a computer consultant that developed several different types of solutions with several different programming languages for several different clients.  In Puerto Rico.  Man... that. was. fun.

certifications.name: Oracle Certified Associate, Java SE 8 Programmer
certifications.title: Oracle Certified Associate, Java SE 8 Programmer
